title: Microsoft Stock (MSFT) Rises 0.7% to $496.13 (Nov 24)
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) rose 0.74% to $496.13 on Nov 24, 2026, as the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.48% on a chip sell-off. No company-specific catalyst was cited.
body_markdown:
Among large tech names,[Apple (AAPL)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/aapl/) gained 1.43% and IBM rose 1.12%, while[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) fell 5.86% and[AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) dropped 8.86%. Microsoft finished 11.27% below its 52-week high of $559.15 and 42.08% above its 52-week low of $349.20.


## Why Microsoft Stock Rose


No source reviewed for this article tied Microsoft's 0.74% gain to company-specific news, so the move is best read against the wider market. According to[Yahoo Finance's live market coverage](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-24-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-chip-stocks-nvidia-140629923.html) on November 24, tech stocks fell, led by declines in the chip sector, as investors weighed what comes next for the AI trade after Nvidia's surge in the prior session on[Jensen Huang's return as CEO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-24-2026/) .


Yahoo Finance also cited the return of rate-hike expectations weighing broadly on stocks, with traders pricing a 95% probability of a 25 basis point Federal Reserve hike in December. Microsoft's gain tracked the Dow rather than the Nasdaq.


In company news, Yahoo Finance reported on November 24, citing internal memos reported by Reuters, that Microsoft declared a code red after a 24-hour outage on November 12 and 13 knocked out Outlook, Teams and Copilot. The goal is to fix future problems worldwide within an hour, after a recent urgent fix took five to six days to reach everyone.


After the close, Maverick Medical AI said in a[press release](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/maverick-medical-ai-surfaces-codeagent-225400029.html) that it will show its CodeAgent assistant inside Microsoft Dragon Copilot at RSNA 2026. Vikram Chhabra, Microsoft's Vice President of Diagnostics Solutions, said in the release, "The future of radiology AI will be built through an ecosystem of innovation." It came after the bell, so it did not drive Tuesday's session.


## MSFT Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Microsoft reported fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue up 19% to $92.3 billion and Azure growth of 48%, and guided to 49% to 50% constant-currency Azure growth this quarter, as summarized by[TipRanks](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/microsoft-msft-one-safest-ways-210600451.html) .
- Daily Copilot users rose nearly 50% from the previous quarter, and commercial remaining performance obligations stood at $677 billion, according to TipRanks.
- Microsoft plans $170 billion in data center spending this year, compared with at least $200 billion each at Amazon and Alphabet, and has kept strong free cash flow, according to[The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/microsoft-best-big-tech-stock-195002703.html) .


### Risks


- Reliability is in focus after the November 12 and 13 outage, which Yahoo Finance reported traced to a flaw in Microsoft's own software that went unnoticed for about four months.
- TipRanks lists infrastructure costs as a possible squeeze on cloud margins, with quarterly capital spending at $45.2 billion including finance leases.
- Competition from Amazon and Google, and a possible slowdown in Copilot adoption, are further risks TipRanks names.
- Rate-hike expectations weighed broadly on stocks on November 24, according to Yahoo Finance.
